activities.name: The Karakoram Highway and Hunza
activities.note: the highway is the only road link north, and it is the one that landslides close

windows.reason: autumn, widely held to be the most scenic season in the valley
the highway is fully open from about May to October and the weather is comfortable enough for sightseeing and trekking
outside that window, severe weather, landslides and flooding disrupt the road far more often
